title: Issue a booking held in manual review
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/sso-bookings.e2e.ts (the airline-card booking issued with ACCOUNT and allowUnpaid).

steps.title: Find the booking
steps.body: Open a booking with ticketing **manual review**.
steps.expect: A banner with the reason and the deadline; **Issue tickets** highlighted.

steps.title: Read the dialog
steps.expect: Stripe authorised: "The authorised payment is captured first". Airline card: "The airline card cannot be charged again…" with **Settlement with the airline** (CASH, ACCOUNT) and, for owner/admin, **Issue although the payment is not captured**. No card field.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.body: Type a reason (3-500 characters), keep "E-mail the e-ticket receipts to the traveller", press **Issue tickets**.
steps.expect: "Tickets issued"; status Ticketed, ticketing Issued; tickets in the Tickets tab.

steps.title: Check the data
steps.body: `SELECT status, ticketing_status, version FROM tenant_<key>.bookings WHERE reference='<ref>';` and `SELECT action, outcome, reason FROM tenant_<key>.staff_actions WHERE booking_id='<id>' ORDER BY created_at;`
steps.expect: `ticketed / issued`, version + 1; `payment.capture` (Stripe only) and `booking.issue` with your reason; `booking_tickets` rows; Mailpit `booking.ticketed`.

steps.title: Try the refusals
steps.body: As an agent, tick nothing and issue an unpaid airline-card booking; double-click Issue on another booking.
steps.expect: Agent: "Only an owner or an admin can issue it unpaid; you can cancel it." Double click: one issuance (one `idempotency_keys` row).
